_doc: SENTINEL watch registry — undated/ongoing tripwires with no calendar window and no engine metric. pending_approval items are NOT being watched; see sentinel_watch.board()['coverage']. Seeded from the 2026-07-31 handoff.

watches.subject: CEG
watches.label: PJM cap/floor regime + data-center backstop procurement
watches.signal: Progression of the data-center backstop procurement plan; cap/floor terms set for the 2029/30 BRA.
watches.why: The entire low-cluster ($296–305) vs high-cluster ($362–441) analyst dispute is about this regime vs the PPA/PTC offset — not about the AI narrative.

watches.subject: CEG
watches.label: Hyperscaler / corporate nuclear PPA tape
watches.signal: Any new long-dated nuclear PPA signed (the Walmart 15-yr / ~176 MW template).
watches.why: The re-rating catalyst — each one prices revenue OUTSIDE the capped PJM capacity market, which is the mechanism claim c5 rests on.

watches.subject: CEG
watches.label: NY 1-yr data-center permit moratorium — spread risk
watches.signal: Other states adopting an environmental-permit moratorium on large data centers.
watches.why: Demand-side political risk to the PPA pipeline (claim c2) that shows up as policy, not as an earnings line.

watches.subject: CEG
watches.label: Follow-on secondary block sales by existing holders
watches.signal: A registered block/secondary (the Jun template: 11M shares @ $281, $3.1B).
watches.why: Supply overhang on the tape — it moves the entry, never the thesis. Relevant to tranche timing, and a red gap on a CONFIRM is not a knife (U-2026-07-31-E).
